plan.classification: Route-level prefill comparison on the current runtime; engine and placement differ.
plan.prerequisites: Close1256-slot117K all-GPU/two-bank admission, then a separately checked old-owned117K request. Verify both retained source/recipe/binary/fixture sets before every process. Freeze full benchmark/config/runtime/model inputs before collection.
plan.decision: Compare first-use separately. For each pair use the ratio of subsequent-request median throughput (three fresh requests/process). Faster screen requires all three ratios>1 and geomean>1.02; slower screen requires all<1 and geomean<1/1.02. Otherwise inconclusive. Nonregression requires geomean>=0.98 and every pair>=0.95. The1000 milestone requires each of three candidate process medians>=1000tok/s.
plan.stopping: Stop on first process, input, route, fault, ownership, budget or sample-eligibility failure. Never retry a root or replace failed samples. No speed-based early stopping.
plan.limits: Two old-first pairs and one new-first pair represent both chronology directions without exact balance. Four requests share a process; the three process pairs are the repetition units.24-output checks do not qualify decode, agent-session, quality or physical262144/session/RESTORE. Neither screen adopts a model route.
